projects.title: Organization and Date Extraction from Public Text

bullets.text: Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the extraction workflow and wrote regression tests with pytest for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, used regular-expression and dictionary rules to extract organization and date spans from public programming questions, then compared extracted spans with provided manually checked examples.
Under supervision, joined document identifiers to post metadata using SQL and checked unmatched records; visualized group comparisons and documented missing-data handling.
